name: cache-meter
description: Context size, prompt cache countdown, subscription limits and subagents above the prompt; per-answer token summary, history pane, per-day stats over all sessions and /keepalive

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: TTL of the prompt cache the session's requests use (1h on subscription, 5m in usage overage or on API)

ctxYellowK.title: Context: yellow from (k tokens)
ctxYellowK.description: Context size in thousands of tokens where the bar turns yellow

ctxOrangeK.title: Context: orange from (k tokens)
ctxOrangeK.description: Context size in thousands of tokens where the bar turns orange

ctxRedK.title: Context: red from (k tokens)
ctxRedK.description: Context size in thousands of tokens where the bar turns red: time to /compact

warnMinutes.title: Warn before cache expiry (minutes)
warnMinutes.description: Notify this many minutes before the prompt cache expires; 0 turns the warning off

autoKeepalive.title: Auto keepalive
autoKeepalive.description: Refresh the prompt cache by itself once before it expires; each message you type allows one more

autoKeepaliveMinutes.title: Auto keepalive before expiry (minutes)
autoKeepaliveMinutes.description: How many minutes before the cache expires the auto keepalive runs

bigResultK.title: Warn on tool results over (k tokens)
bigResultK.description: Toast when one tool result adds more than this many thousand tokens to the context; 0 turns it off

repeatReads.title: Warn when a file is read this many times
repeatReads.description: Toast when the same file has been read into the context this many times; 0 turns it off

confirmExpiredK.title: Ask before sending over an expired cache from (k tokens)
confirmExpiredK.description: When the cache has expired and the context is at least this many thousand tokens, ask before a message rewrites it, offering to compact first; 0 never asks

confirmSwitchK.title: Ask before /model or /effort from (k tokens)
confirmSwitchK.description: While the cache lives and the context is at least this many thousand tokens, ask before /model or /effort throws the cache away; 0 never asks
